question: All India Kisan Sabha was founded in 1936 at Indian National Congress (INC) __________ Session as All India Kisan Congress.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• All India Kisan Sabha(AIKS) has culminated in the Lucknow session of the Indian National Congress__ held on 11th April 1936.
 
• This session was presided by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• The Communist Party of India was established on 26th December 1925 which took over the All India Kisan Sabha in 1942.
 
• The Communist Party of India(Marxist) is later established by the Bifurcation of the Communist Party of India based on ideology in 1964.
 
• The Congress Socialist Party was based on the ideology of Fabianism as well as Marxism-Leninism similar to CPI(M) which was established in 1934 & dissolved in 1948.
 
• Though the Kisan Sabha movement started in Bihar under the leadership of Sahajanand Saraswati in 1929, the All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) was established at the Lucknow session of the Indian National Congress on 11 April 1936.
